statements: given $item_item_id_2: string, $item_stock_2: integer, $account_account_id_2: string, $item_stock_3: integer, $purchase_order_id: string; match $item isa! item; $item has item-id $item_item_id; $item_item_id isa! item-id; $item_item_id == $item_item_id_2; $item has stock $item_stock; $item_stock isa! stock; $item_stock > $item_stock_2; $account isa! account; $account has account-id $account_account_id; $account_account_id isa! account-id; $account_account_id == $account_account_id_2; $account has balance $account_balance; $account_balance isa! balance; $item has price $item_price; $item_price isa! price; $account_balance >= $item_price; let $item_stock_4 = ($item_stock - $item_stock_3); let $account_balance_2 = ($account_balance - $item_price); update $item has stock == $item_stock_4; $account has balance == $account_balance_2; insert $purchase isa purchase, links (buyer: $account, item: $item), has order-id == $purchase_order_id;
